evidence: User asked that ULTRAKILL guns hurt Minecraft mobs and Minecraft weapons hurt ULTRAKILL enemies. Decompiled RevolverBeam, Projectile, Nail, Explosion, Punch and Harpoon all find targets on layers 10/11 with Head/Body/Limb tags and an EnemyIdentifierIdentifier, then call EnemyIdentifier.DeliverDamage; a Harmony prefix on DeliverDamage forwards hits on Minecraft-mob hitboxes to Java. The inherited SkyCombat actor table and EV_HIT_ACTOR event mirror native enemies as invisible hittable Minecraft stand-ins. One revolver shot (multiplier 1) = 10 Minecraft damage (half a zombie); a diamond sword (7) = 0.7 native damage (kills a Filth).
